sources.title: Prinz Eugen
sources.excerpt: She has [[aqua eyes]] and [[long hair|long]] [[blonde hair]] in [[twintails]] tied with [[anchor_hair_ornament|anchor hair ornaments]]. She wears a [[military uniform]] similar to [[bismarck (kancolle)|Bismarck]]'s. Unlike the other Kriegsmarine girls in the game however, her uniform is not bottomless. Instead she wears a [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[black skirt|black]] [[microskirt]]. She also wears short [[black thighighs|black]] [[over-kneehighs]] that barely reach above her knees.
